images.prompt:
Original hand-painted botanical gouache for a premium romantic cottagecore crochet-pattern bundle, on softly textured warm cream paper. Use elegant layered floral and foliage forms, fine organic warm brown-charcoal ink outlines, restrained editorial detail, delicate dry-brush texture and gentle natural gouache shading. Palette: soft blush, muted rose, dusty sage, lavender and small powder-blue accents, with warm charcoal typography. Airy, refined, poetic and quietly moonlit; full-colour printable design with generous space and crisp legibility, never photographic.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Hand-painted botanical gouache with an original romantic cottagecore editorial sensibility; refined, decorative botanical illustration rather than photography or scientific plate reproduction.; line weight: Fine, restrained warm brown-charcoal ink outlines with occasional delicate interior contouring.; line quality: Graceful, slightly organic hand-drawn lines; clean enough for premium digital print, never sketchy or scratchy.; detail level: Moderately detailed layered botanical forms, with detail concentrated in petals, foliage, stems and small decorative flourishes; generous unpainted space preserves a calm premium finish.; background density: Airy cream-paper grounds with sparse botanical accents, faint tonal washes and occasional understated framing devices; backgrounds always recede behind titles and practical information.; composition: Elegant editorial hierarchy with one clear botanical focal area, balanced vertical flow, ample calm space for legible titles or instructions, and delicate dividers used sparingly.; palette: Warm cream foundation with soft blush, muted rose, dusty sage, gentle lavender and small powder-blue accents, anchored by warm brown-charcoal typography; low-saturation colours with harmonious dusk-like contrast.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Soft gouache layering, gentle tonal gradients and subtle cool-to-warm shadowing; no hard digital highlights, heavy contrast or glossy effects.; texture: Visible but delicate cold-press paper grain, dry-brush edges and softly varied opaque gouache pigment, retained subtly for reliable home printing.; mood: Poetic, romantic, tranquil and heirloom-inspired, with a quietly enchanted botanical atmosphere..

PAGE 1 of "Moonlit Meadow Crochet Bouquet Pattern Bundle" (cover): Cover artwork: upright illustrated meadow flower bouquet in the lower third, including rose, lavender, blush, sage and small powder-blue wildflower accents; small crescent moon medallion centred above bouquet; title text exactly “MOONLIT MEADOW”; subtitle exactly “Crochet Bouquet Pattern Bundle”; small line exactly “33 patterns • US terms”; delicate botanical dividers and faint twilight meadow wash, with spacious editorial title hierarchy.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a solid or softly textured coloured background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is an illustration for a printable crochet pattern collection (cover art or a decorative illustration). It is clearly an illustration, not a photograph, and contains no written instructions, stitch diagrams, charts or step text. Portrait A4 and US Letter-compatible cream-ground editorial pages with ample clear space for practical text and home-print-friendly restrained ink coverage. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Photography, photorealism or realistic product mock-ups; Copied vintage botanical plates, identifiable layouts or derivative branded artwork; Crochet hooks, yarn balls, stitch diagrams or finished crochet objects within the decorative illustrations; Harsh neon colours, glossy digital gradients or heavy black shadows; Crowded page layouts, excessive ink coverage or unreadably fine details; Misspelled text, illegible decorative lettering or low-contrast typography.
